mentions.name: The Next Shift Widget
mentions.description: This iOS widget displays work shifts better than the default calendar app, showing overnight shifts properly in the zoomed-out monthly view and counting how many shifts were completed in a month, with a nice look.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a widget that better shows my work shifts (I work nights and the default calendar app displays overnights as two days in the zoomed out monthly view, so this improves upon that and also counts how many shifts I've completed in a month while looking nice too).
